data.title: Condo transfers to foreigners rise 1.4% in Q2 2026, REIC reports
data.description: Chinese buyers led Thailand’s foreign condo transfers, but the first-half 2026 total fell 8.8% to 6,533 units despite a second-quarter recovery

data.title: Korat’s almost B90M in abandoned public facilities raise questions over state spending
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA — Locals of Nakhon Ratchasima have begun questioning the management of state-funded projects after a public library and observatory, built at a cost of nearly 90 million baht, had public access rescinded and were left to deterioriate for over a decade.

data.title: Central Pattana Wins ICSC MAXI Award 2026 for Thai Heritage Christmas Trees
data.description: Central Pattana brings Thai creativity to the global stage as the Only Thai Company to win at the ‘2026 ICSC GLOBAL MAXI AWARDS’ in the US with ‘11 One-of-a-Kind Christmas Trees’ rooted in Thai heritage

data.title: Former abbot, woman remanded over alleged financial misconduct
data.description: Police presented the former abbot of Wat Phutthaisawan in Ayutthaya and a woman accused of acting his accomplice to their first remand hearing after investigators alleged that more than 100 million baht in temple donations had been misappropriated.

data.title: Over 30% of unmarried people in Japan do not want children: survey
data.description: KYODO — More than 30% of unmarried people aged between 18 and 34 in Japan do not wish to have children, the highest percentage since comparable data became available in 2002, a government survey showed Friday.

data.title: Pataya Food Group Partners with Japan’s Umios to Drive Asian Growth
data.description: BANGKOK — Pataya Food Group (PFG) , owner of Nautilus, Mongkut Talay, Sea Crown, Regalos, and Remy, announces a strategic partnership with Umios Corporation (Japan) to accelerate growth across Asia. The alliance combines PFG’s strengths in brand building and channel management with Umios Group’s global network and industry expertise. Together, the companies aim to support PFG's ambition of achieving average annual growth of 10% , guided by the shared mission of “Enrich People's Life.”

data.title: Italian feminist fighter Emma Bonino dies
data.description: ROME - Italy's Emma Bonino, a long-time radical activist and one of the country's most popular political figures, has died aged 78.

data.title: Thai FDA reports no national medicine shortage amid local supply gaps
data.description: A fact-finding report is expected within three days after a medicine shortage was confirmed at the Chiang Mai hospital, while the FDA reports no nationwide medicine shortage.

data.title: Armed robber takes B1.5m  from Pathum Thani bank, burns getaway car
data.description: PATHUM THANI - An armed robber who made off with 1.5 million baht after robbing a bank in Khlong Luang district on Thursday afternoon later set fire to the car he used in the heist in an apparent attempt to destroy evidence.

data.title: Indonesia to bring back baby orangutans allegedly trafficked to India
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesian authorities have begun working to repatriate five baby orangutans allegedly trafficked to India, where they were found motherless in a forest, Jakarta's forestry ministry told AFP Friday.

data.title: Fast-pace dance takes I.Coast's working-class streets by storm
data.description: ABIDJAN - On the streets of a working-class Abidjan neighbourhood, hundreds of young people gather every week after class to dance the biama, a high-tempo combo of acrobatic twists, frenetic footwork and funny facial expressions.

data.title: Thai-Malaysian families could be impacted by shortened visa-free stay
data.description: Malaysians married to Thai nationals could be the group affected by the 30-day visa-free programme which will take effect next week.

data.title: 'Desperate' Sabalenka books US Open title clash with Rybakina
data.description: NEW YORK — Aryna Sabalenka stormed past Jessica Pegula in straight sets on Thursday to keep her bid for a rare US Open three-peat on track, booking a championship showdown with Elena Rybakina.

data.title: How Homprung by Baihor is reimagining Thailand’s herbal heritage through contemporary art
data.description: In Bangkok Old Town, where generations of history and traditional knowledge remain embedded in everyday life, a contemporary herbal space is creating a new way to encounter Thailand’s cultural heritage.

data.title: Myanmar airport shut after rebel drone attack
data.description: MANDALAY — Myanmar's second-busiest airport was closed for two days on Friday, security sources told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ), a day after the military-backed government accused pro-democracy rebels of attacking it with drones.

data.title: 338 MPs back 2027 budget bill, including 58 MPs from opposition Klatham
data.description: Thegovernment secured overwhelming support in the House for the 2027 budget bill, with 338 MPs voting in favour, including 58 MPs from the opposition Klatham Party of Capt Thamanat Prompow.

data.title: Siam Global House Expands BESS Across Thailand
data.description: BANGKOK, Aug 31, 2026 — Siam Global House Public Company Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with AESCON Co Ltd and Integra R.E. Co Ltd to jointly develop and deploy Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) solutions across its branch network, marking a significant step toward smarter and more resilient energy management across its operations. The MOU was signed at Huawei’s Digital Power Hall headquarters in Shenzhen, China.

data.title: Government needs to build public confidence on disaster alerts
data.description: Almost half of people have shown no trust in the disaster warning system in a KPI Poll, which reflected more attempts were needed to boost their confidence.

data.title: Putin in India for Brics summit overshadowed by war
data.description: NEW DELHI - Russian President Vladimir Putin was in India on Friday for talks ahead of an 11-member BRICS (Brics) summit dominated by conflict and economic challenges, with the leaders of China and Iran set to attend.

data.title: A succession battle erupts over a late Ugandan monarch
data.description: NEW YORK — A television anchor. A young, mysterious heir. An amateur football player nicknamed “Big G.” Those were the people offered as candidates for the throne of the Tooro Kingdom in Uganda, after its former boy king died of cancer at age 34 last month.

data.description: MANCHESTER — Enzo Maresca faces his first major test since stepping into Pep Guardiola's shoes as City visit United in the Manchester derby on Sunday, while Arsenal aim to extend their flawless start at Sunderland.

data.title: The Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists convicted in national security trial
data.description: HONG KONG - A Hong Kong court sentenced three pro-democracy activists on Friday who organised annual vigils to mark China's deadly Tiananmen crackdown on charges of "incitement to subversion".

data.title: Appreciation, anger await as Trump heads to Irish golf resort
data.description: DOONBEG — In the windswept village of Doonbeg on Ireland's Atlantic coast, Donald Trump is less polarising United States president and more golf resort owner credited with bringing jobs and money to a remote corner of the country.

data.title: Party leaders trade barbs before Swedish election
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Sweden's party leaders traded barbs on housing, schools, jobs and the climate in one of their final televised debates ahead of Sunday's general election, which could see a left-wing government come to power.

data.title: STGT Unveils Future of Gloves at IRGCE 2026, Setting Global Clean World Standard
data.description: Sri Trang Gloves (Thailand) Public Company Limited (STGT), a global leader in sustainable rubber glove manufacturing and distribution, is reinforcing its role in shaping the future of the rubber glove industry on the international stage through its participation in the 12th International Rubber Glove Conference & Exhibition (IRGCE 2026), held at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, Malaysia, from 8 – 10 September 2026. At the event, STGT highlighted its “Clean World Clean Gloves” (CWCG) concept as a key framework for elevating industry standards beyond product quality and performance to encompass transparency, responsibility, and sustainability throughout the entire value chain.

data.title: “Siam Paragon Bangkok Watch Week 2026” elevates Bangkok as a global watch destination
data.description: BANGKOK, Thailand — Siam Paragon, reaffirming its position as a global landmark and one of the world’s premier Global Luxury Destinations, is set to host a defining landmark of haute horology with the second edition of “Siam Paragon Bangkok Watch Week 2026.” The event is a “Celebration of Watch Culture,” bringing new depth and perspective to the world of horology through an exceptional gathering of more than 45 prestigious international watch maisons, renowned industry leaders, discerning collectors and passionate enthusiasts from across the globe.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rambolek stripped of title on scale after missing weight
data.description: Thailand’s Rambolek Chor Ajalaboon has lost his ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai world title on the scale after missing weight in Bangkok – leaving Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri as the only man who can claim the vacant belt at The Inner Circle 30.

data.title: Statecraft or scripture: Why Pacific nations want Jerusalem embassies
data.description: SYDNEY — An ancient Biblical prophecy lies at the heart of a Pacific islands push to open embassies on contested ground in Jerusalem, experts and former diplomats told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ).

data.title: China, Iran among countries that have used AI to aid spying, Anthropic says
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO - Anthropic said on Thursday it shut down multiple cases of state-sponsored surveillance operations that used its artificial intelligence (AI) models, and warned that governments and state-aligned actors are increasingly using AI to spy on ethnic minorities and dissidents.
